scope: Remaining 21 pairs (queue positions 15-35) from duplicate_conflict_review_queue_round33.json. Kept V and T frames were visually inspected; the first five pairs also had kept/dropped V/T label text compared. This is a class-presence and approximate-object-count audit, not bounding-box adjudication.
